title: TCL 43S5400A (43" FHD, S5400A series), Indonesia unit: device C06, product C06_2K_GB, model "Smart TV".
header:
TCL 43S5400A (43" FHD, S5400A series), Indonesia unit: device C06, product C06_2K_GB, model "Smart TV".
Android TV 11 (SDK 30), build AR2101 / AR21, TCL software V8-T221T05-LF1V320, security patch 2025-03-05.
MediaTek MT9221 (ro.board.platform mt5867), 4x Cortex-A55, about 1 GB RAM (low_ram=true).
43" variant of the C06_2K_GB platform (see also tcl-40s5400a and tcl-32s5400a).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-43s5400a/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-43s5400a/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (the restore.sh / build-and-install.sh default).
Live TV app: com.tcl.tv (also handles HDMI inputs via VIEW intent).
Inputs: com.tcl.tvinput (2x HDMI, AV, tuner).

Applied on 2026-10-21 with verification screenshots after each batch:
- CleanYourTV launcher boots as default Home screen.
- YouTube, Vidio, Jellyfin, and Netflix open and play cleanly.
- HDMI 1, HDMI 2, AV, and Live TV switch properly via launcher's Inputs menu.
- Free RAM increased from ~100 MB to ~328 MB.

Known quirks on this firmware:
- Stock tvlauncher declares HOME priority 2, so cmd package set-home-activity alone does not
take Home while it is enabled. Disabling it (as build-and-install.sh does) is required.
- com.tcl.ttvs is the firmware updater, not text-to-speech. Kept for OTA updates.
- com.tcl.usercenter is re-enabled by the system at boot (remains idle).
- Photo screensaver (com.google.android.backdrop) uses ~105 MB RAM. Switch to ClockDream before disabling:
tools/tv.py 'settings put secure screensaver_components com.gathin.tvhome/.ClockDream'

DO NOT DISABLE on this TV (vital system services):
com.tcl.tv                           # Live TV app, plays HDMI, source picker on Input key
com.tcl.tvinput                      # TV input services for HDMI, AV and tuner
com.tcl.ttvs                         # TCL firmware update service (kept for OTA updates)
com.tcl.system.server                # remote-key plumbing
com.tcl.tcl_bt_rcu_service           # Bluetooth remote service
com.tcl.autopair                     # Bluetooth remote auto-pairing
com.tcl.settings                     # picture & sound settings
com.tcl.suspension                   # source panel / Quick Panel
com.tcl.keyhelp                      # virtual keys
com.android.vending                  # Google Play Store
com.google.android.gms               # Google Play Services
com.google.android.gsf               # Google Services Framework
com.google.android.apps.mediashell   # Chromecast built-in

apps.note: TCL account, re-enabled by system at boot (idle)
Google Assistant (~52 MB RAM, mic button)

sections.title: Setup wizard (safe to disable after initial TV setup)
Stock screensaver (backdrop eats ~105 MB RAM; replace with ClockDream)
